about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.

4abba57.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. index.html plus the three js/ files that put a pixel on screen: js/10_assets.js makes the textures, js/20_level.js the lit materials, js/40_render.js is the rasterizer. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire, blob by blob, against the deployed page.

shots.note: RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #536, in the same page load as level0-spawn and shot LAST in it, because DEV.clear() drops the level's own hostiles. Build proved off the wire as the other level-0 rows: twelve served blobs md5-match main at 4abba57. Route: freeze at load, S.t = 4 and a re-freeze, banner('', 0), DEV.tick(30), P.hp = 100, DEV.cam(18.5, 5.5, floorAt(18.5, 5.5), 0.60, 0), DEV.clear(), DEV.spawn('grunt', 1, 6), grainSeed = 6, DEV.tick(1). DEV.spawn reports the body it realised at (23.45, 8.89), cell (23, 8), range exactly 6.00 m, why 'exact' - no clamp, no lateral rescue; e.anim 0, MAP.fz 0 like the camera, MAP.light 0.4223, HUD 1 LEFT. Frame mean 68.09, thirds 61.0 / 66.3 / 77.0, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34, against 68.23 on the bytes this replaces. The wall behind him and the roof over it are the shipped surfaces - #369's corner is the only new term - so a body keeps the light #495 and #18 gave it.

RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #536; same page load and deal as level0-spawn (layout 3105224175). Build proved off the wire as above: all twelve served blobs md5-match main at 4abba57. Pose DEV.cam(1.5, 8.5, floorAt(1.5, 8.5), Math.PI/2, 0), read back (1.5, 8.5) floor 0.00 ang 1.5708 pitch 0. The flight at (1, 9)..(1, 13) still reads MAP.fz 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 with MAP.feat 0, 1, 1, 1, 0 - three STAIR cells - so the four risers the caption names are this deal's. Frame mean 46.77, thirds 39.1 / 54.3 / 46.9, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 15 under 34 with a longest run of 1 from row 18, against 46.71 / 15 rows / run 1 from 18 on the bytes this replaces. THE DEAL HELD; the stairwell's darkness did not come back. Six of this frame's pixels-per-row are the #369 corner, which is the only thing in it that differs from the replaced arm, and it moves the mean by 0.06.

RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #536; same page load and deal as level0-spawn. Build proved off the wire as above. Pose DEV.cam(19.5, 14.5, floorAt(19.5, 14.5), Math.atan2(2, 1), 0), read back (19.5, 14.5) floor -1.00 ang 1.1071 pitch 0. Frame mean 62.14, thirds 47.4 / 86.6 / 52.5, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34, against 61.82 / 46.6 / 86.5 / 52.5 on the bytes this replaces. This is the frame that moved most in the set, +0.32, and it moved UP: #518 finds a slab's underside from what is overhead rather than by touch, so the low ceiling over the hole is solved as the underside of the deck the camera stands on and stops reading as an unlit sheet. The replaced row's explanation - that lighting the roof took 0.57 OUT of this frame - described #495 against an older arm and is not what these bytes show against the bytes they replace.

RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #536; same page load and deal as level0-spawn. Build proved off the wire as above. Pose DEV.cam(20.5, 11.5, floorAt(20.5, 11.5), Math.PI/2, 0); the pit block (19..21, 14..16) re-reads MAP.fz -4 on all nine cells, so a pit under a lip inside tall air stays a pit. Frame mean 57.67, thirds 48.6 / 64.0 / 60.4, rows 0 under 24, 1 under 34 (run 1 from 536) - every one of those digits is the replaced row's to the hundredth. The bytes are not identical: #369 re-values the roof-to-wall corner and #518 re-solves a slab's underside, and in THIS frame that reaches only a thin band, so the mean holds while the picture is a newer picture.

RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #536, in the first page load of the pass. Build proved off the wire before the shutter: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs the page served were md5-compared against main at 4abba57 and all twelve matched, so these pixels came off the page that serves that tree (#395, #420). Route: DEV.freeze(true) the moment the page answers, S.t = 4 then DEV.freeze(true) again so the pin lands in T0 (js/90_dev.js:42 restores S.t = T0 every frozen frame, so the assignment alone is undone by the next tick), banner('', 0), DEV.tick(30), P.hp = 100, then the dealt spawn seat read off the page - (18.5, 5.5) heading 0.60 - grainSeed = 6 and one DEV.tick(1). Layout 3105224175, the same deal the replaced row named, so every coordinate in the caption is still this room: 8 hostiles, 23 props, 13 lights. Frame mean 68.13, thirds 61.1 / 66.3 / 77.0, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34, against 68.26 on the bytes this replaces. THE DEAL HELD and the picture is a hair DARKER, not brighter: #369 gave the roof-to-wall corner a value taken from the face it meets, so the thin band at the top of this frame lost a little light while the room's own light is #495's in both arms. What moved between these bytes and the last pass is #369 and #518, not layout.

RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #536, in its own page load (one url, one boot - a second DEV.boot() inside a load keeps drawing from the advanced stream). Build proved off the wire: all twelve served blobs md5-match main at 4abba57. Route: DEV.freeze(true) at load, DEV.boot(), startLevel(2, true), banner('', 0), S.t = 4 then a re-freeze, DEV.tick(30), P.hp = 100, then the dealt spawn seat (17.5, 28.5) heading 0.60, grainSeed = 6 and DEV.tick(1). THE DEAL HELD (layout 469427782), so the seat, 40 props, 24 lights and 18 hostiles are this room still. Frame mean 68.46, thirds 51.6 / 67.7 / 86.2, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34 - every digit is the replaced row's to the hundredth. The slab over the room is the largest surface in frame and is where #518's overhead-solve applies, so the bytes moved; the slab's own band reads 51.6 in both arms, which is why the mean is too.

RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #536; the same seat, deal and page load as level2-abatoir, turned to the nearest hung fitting this deal puts within reach of the frame. Build proved off the wire as the seat row - all twelve served blobs md5-match main at 4abba57. MAP.ceilPanes holds FOUR entries on this layout; the nearest with d > 1.5 re-read this load at (20.12, 26.88), 3.08 m from the seat at bearing -0.5538 rad, lens at z 2.35 under a slab top of 4.00 - unchanged from the replaced row. Pose DEV.cam(seat, -0.5538, 194.2), where 194.2 px = atan2(2.35 - eyeZ 0.50, 3.08) * BH 359, re-solved off the live page rather than typed from the row. Frame mean 70.29, thirds 68.5 / 79.2 / 63.2, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34, the same four digits the replaced row carried: a camera looking at a lit lens is the one place in this set where #369 and #518 have almost nothing to say.

RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #536, in its own page load: DEV.freeze(true) at load, DEV.boot(), startLevel(3, true), banner('', 0), S.t = 4 then a re-freeze, DEV.tick(30), P.hp = 100, DEV.cam(1.5, 2.5, floorAt(1.5, 2.5), 0.60, 0), grainSeed = 6, DEV.tick(1). Build proved off the wire: all twelve served blobs md5-match main at 4abba57. Layout 972763321 - the hand-authored plan is unchanged - 4 hostiles, 9 props, 11 lights. Frame mean 57.58, thirds 51.2 / 62.8 / 58.7, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34, which is every digit the replaced row printed, including its 0-rows-under-34: the darkness the #536 pass removed is still removed. What these bytes add over the ones they replace is #369's corner where the slab face the seat opens into meets the vault, and #518's overhead-solve on the slab the seat stands under; both are thin, which is why the means and band means land on the old digits while the file's hash does not.
